CS4223 requires CS2106 and (CS3210 or CS3220 or CG3207). CS3210 requires CS2100 (completed) but also CS2106. CS2106 requires CS2100. However, CS4223 also requires CS3210/CS3220/CG3207. CG3207 requires EE2026 and CG2028/EE2028. CS3220 is not offered. CS3210 is offered Sem 1/2. To take CS4223 in Sem 7 or 8, one must take CS3210 in Sem 5 or 6. But CS3210 prerequisite is CS2100 (done) OR others. Wait, CS3210 prereq is CS2100 or CS2100DE or CS2100HS or CG2007 or EE2028 or CG2028 or EE2024. Student has CS2100. So CS3210 can be taken in Sem 5. Then CS4223 can be taken in Sem 7. This part is feasible. The main blocker is CS3263 and the CS3103/CS2102 dependency chain combined with MC limits.
